scripts.build:package-deps: npm run -w @tikz-editor/lezer-tikz build && npm run -w @tikz-editor/lang-tikz build
scripts.generate:example-previews: npm run build:package-deps && node --import tsx scripts/generate-open-example-previews.ts
scripts.debug:multiline: npm run build:package-deps && node --import tsx scripts/capture-multiline-debug.ts
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:package-deps && env -u NO_COLOR FORCE_COLOR=0 playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:firefox: npm run build:package-deps && env -u NO_COLOR FORCE_COLOR=0 PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS=firefox playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:webkit: npm run build:package-deps && env -u NO_COLOR FORCE_COLOR=0 PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS=webkit playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:all-browsers: npm run build:package-deps && env -u NO_COLOR FORCE_COLOR=0 PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS=chromium,firefox,webkit playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:headed: npm run build:package-deps && env -u NO_COLOR FORCE_COLOR=0 playwright test --headed
scripts.test:e2e:ci: npm run build:package-deps && env -u NO_COLOR FORCE_COLOR=0 playwright test --reporter=line
scripts.profile:landing: env -u NO_COLOR FORCE_COLOR=0 playwright test --config profiling/playwright.landing.config.ts profiling/profile-landing.spec.ts
